helpArticleContent.title: Editing someone’s details
helpArticleContent.oneSentenceAnswer: Open their card and choose Edit — people with a Patina account manage their own name, email, and phone.

children.text: It's the same door everywhere in People: a rolodex card, a field crew member, a client's household — find their card, choose Edit, change what changed, save.
The one exception: someone with a Patina account keeps their own name, email, and phone — their card still opens, but those three fields live in their account, not yours to change.
